title: flamingo flock (animated point-cloud)
notes: 5 flamingos sampled into 12k particles each, flying in V formation, wings flap via shader-side x-distance-driven sin oscillation, slowly drift forward. Hot-pink → coral → cream palette. Loads from threejs.org/examples (same CDN that worked for Lucy). 2.8s reveal: particles arc in from above the screen into formation. Recognizable bird shape, animated, real form.
